verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is PRELOAD_MODELS / --preload-models, which takes a JSON list of model installs, so multiple models can be applied in one operation at startup. Nothing else shows general bulk operations. missing for 10: a batch inference API (e.g., an OpenAI-style Batch endpoint), bulk management of models, agents or users at runtime via API/CLI/UI, documentation of multi-item operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
